output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself and do not wait for a reply in this thread. Crushing central chest pressure spreading to your left arm with sweating and nausea can mean a heart attack, and it needs an ECG and blood tests immediately. Stay with someone if possible and follow the dispatcher's instructions until help arrives.
